userdoc.notice: Freezes a completed "cupboard" (7 fully-upgraded artifacts, one per Form value, sharing one Site+Age+Material combination) into a permanent, soulbound Badge. Deliberately does not inherit ERC1155 or ERC721 - it burns JaccardERC1155 tokens and mints Badges by writing AppStorage directly instead of calling into JaccardERC1155Facet or BadgesFacet, because facets are separate contracts that only share storage via delegatecall, not each other's internal Solidity functions (see JaccardERC1155Facet._mintEssenceERC20/_burnEssenceERC20 for the established precedent this mirrors).
